what: Pressing the menu button makes the drawer panel sweep in diagonally from the bottom right (its own height + 250px below, half its width to the right). It runs 1.8s cubic-bezier(.84,.12,.83,.36) starting from -1s, skipping the slow front part and accelerating into place over the remaining .8s. The art behind the panel (an arm like a cat’s front paw, wide at the top and long downward) is 1.55× wider than the panel and rises 250px above, running off screen. Content turns on .8s later over .3s. On close, content turns off over .3s and the panel goes back along the same path over .6s linear. While open, the body is fixed in place so the page behind doesn’t scroll

options.open: Open button selector, default [aria-controls="<Panel id>"] or the document’s [data-fx-part=open]
options.lock: If false the body is not locked (default true — like the original, it remembers the scroll position on open and fixes the body)
options.--fx-dur: Opening duration (css variable), default 1.8s — shorten it for apps that open and close often
options.--fx-skip: Share of the opening curve to skip (negative delay, css variable), default -1s
options.--fx-rise: Distance below where the panel hides (added to panel height, css variable), default 250px
options.[data-fx-part=bg]: Art behind the board (arm/paw svg) — 1.55 times wider than the board and rises 250px above it
options.[data-fx-part=body]: Content inside the panel — turns on after .8s

use: …
note: The panel sits at position: fixed, top left (original width 52%, max 550px). So that no horizontal overflow appears while the panel is hidden off screen, body must be overflow-x: clip. Closes with Esc, the close button, or pressing again
